name: Trailer couch
summary: A movie trailer someone shared turns into a movie night on a drawn living room couch: tap a cushion to sit, claim a snack on the coffee table, pick a showtime and lock it; the floor beanbag is always somebody's.
useWhen: WE ARE WATCHING THIS (someone shared a trailer)
movie night at ours when it comes out, who's in
trailer just dropped, pick a showtime and who brings snacks
who's watching the new heist movie on the couch friday
save me a seat for the premiere watch
dontUseWhen: choosing which movie to watch (use movie-bracket)
going out to a theater with tickets to split (use ticket-split)
a watch party for a pile of funny reels (use reel-rank)

opens.description: When it comes out, e.g. 'out Friday'

quote.description: What they said, in their words

seats.description: 3 to 6 cushions: the name sitting there, or empty for free

beanbag.description: Whose floor beanbag it is (the running joke), or empty

snacks.description: 2 to 4 snacks on the coffee table

kind.description: popcorn, candy, chips, soda or pizza
